title: 第7章 明悟自身培养后辈第8章 不周禁区前往西方
slug: 洪荒开局吞噬十一祖巫
content_zh:
盘古神殿深处，空气在法则的萦绕下静静流淌。
帝江沉浸在深层次的修炼中，不仅是在锤炼法力、感悟大道，更是在与体内那磅礴浩瀚的盘古血脉进行着更深层次的交融。
随着血脉之力被不断激发、纯化，一股源自生命本源的、沉甸甸的意志，如同沉睡的火山般，在帝江心间缓缓苏醒。
那不是具体的记忆，而是一种烙印在祖巫血脉深处的本能，一种不容置疑的责任——守护。
守护父神盘古以自身一切所化的这片洪荒天地！
这股意志纯粹而强大，无声地冲刷着帝江的意识，让他对这片天地产生了一种前所未有的归属感与使命感。
山川河流，星辰日月，乃至一草一木，都仿佛是他需要看顾的家产。
前世的记忆与今生的感悟在此刻交织。
“原来如此！”
帝江心中明悟，缓缓睁开双眼，眸中闪过一丝复杂！
“前世的十二祖巫，哪怕没有元神，不视天数，行事看似鲁莽霸道，一心只想称霸洪荒，其血脉深处最根本的驱动力，恐怕也是想以他们自己的方式，占据并守护盘古留下的这片世界吧。”
他们或许不懂天道运转，不明白因果纠缠，只是单纯地认为，唯有将洪荒掌控在巫族手中，才能避免被外人破坏，才能更好地维护盘古的遗泽。
只可惜，方法错了。
巫妖大战，席卷天地，打碎了洪荒，造成的破坏远比他们想要阻止的更多，最终事与愿违。
“称霸，战争，带来的只有毁灭。”
帝江摇了摇头，眼神逐渐变得坚定而清明，无论那场大劫背后是否有鸿钧的影子，是否有其他圣人的算计，其破坏的根基，都是盘古留下的洪荒天地！
这是绝对无法容忍的！”
他低头看向下方那浩瀚的盘古血池。
按照原本的轨迹，十二祖巫会以自身精血混合血池能量，创造出无数的巫族子民，作为他们争霸洪荒的根基。
但现在，这一世，有我帝江在，便不需要再用这种方式了。

很快帝江便做出了决定，不会再用自身精血去大规模创造巫族。
至于那六个正在血池中孕育的先天大巫，是盘古血池自然孕育，是合法继承人，他会引导、培养他们。
但大规模制造种族，卷入无休止的霸权争夺，进而引发毁天量劫，这条路，他绝不走！
“巫妖大战这个局，无论输赢，我都不入了。”
帝江嘴角勾起一抹超然的笑意！
“赢了如何？输了又如何？打烂的都是自家的东西！
鸿钧想合道，天道想完善，你们自己去玩，别扯上我，更别想毁坏洪荒根本！”
他虽然是个穿越者，但深知在这洪荒世界，盘古正宗这个身份，才是他最大的倚仗和根基所在。
维护洪荒天地的完整与繁荣，从某种意义上说，就是在维护他自身存在的合法性与气运。
这与他的血脉本能、自身利益完全一致。
“我的路，是超脱，是守护，而非破坏。”
帝江重新闭上双眼，周身道韵愈发深邃玄奥，“不断提升自身实力，直至混元大罗金仙，乃至更高。
拥有足够的力量，才能真正的说话算话，才能在任何风波中，护住这不周山，护住这盘古开辟的天地。”
“至于那些灵宝、机缘不过是护道之器。
真正的道，在于自身，在于对这方天地的责任。”
想通了这一点，帝江感觉自己的道心更加通透，与盘古血脉的融合也更为顺畅。
他不再去纠结于前世的剧情，也不再急于参与洪荒的纷争。
他现在要做的，就是宅在不周山这个安全区里，默默积蓄力量，等待时机。
当拥有足够实力时，他自然有资格制定规则，维护他想维护的一切。
盘古神殿内，法则的辉光再次将帝江笼罩。

这一次，他对前路有了更明确的目标和更坚定的道心——为了守护而变强。
既然决定了不走疯狂爆兵、争霸洪荒的老路，帝江便将目光投向了盘古血池中那六个沉浮不定的先天大巫血胎。
这几位，可是未来巫族真正的精华，是他在洪荒为数不多的自己人，必须好好培养。
content_en:
Deep in the Pangu Temple, the air flows quietly under the influence of laws.
Di Jiang is immersed in deep-level cultivation, not only tempering his magic power and comprehending the Tao, but also integrating at a deeper level with the majestic and vast Pangu bloodline in his body.
As the power of blood is continuously stimulated and purified, a heavy will originating from the origin of life slowly awakens in Di Jiang's heart like a sleeping volcano.
That is not a specific memory, but an instinct imprinted deep in the blood of the ancestral witch, an unquestionable responsibility - to protect.
Protect this ancient world that Father God Pangu transformed with everything he has!
This will was pure and powerful, silently washing over Di Jiang's consciousness, giving him an unprecedented sense of belonging and mission to this world.
The mountains and rivers, the stars, the sun and the moon, and even the plants and trees, all seemed to be his property that needed to be taken care of.
Memories of past lives and perceptions of this life are intertwined at this moment.
"That's it!"
Di Jiang understood clearly in his heart and slowly opened his eyes, with a hint of complexity flashing in his eyes!
"The Twelve Ancestral Witches in the previous life, even though they did not have souls, did not regard the destiny of the gods, and acted recklessly and domineeringly. They only wanted to dominate the ancient world. The most fundamental driving force deep in their bloodline was probably that they wanted to occupy and protect the world left by Pangu in their own way."
They may not understand the operation of heaven and the entanglement of cause and effect, but simply believe that only by controlling the prehistoric period in the hands of the Wu clan can they avoid being destroyed by outsiders and better safeguard Pangu's legacy.
Unfortunately, the method is wrong.
The Lich War swept across the world, shattering the ancient world, causing far more damage than they intended to prevent, and ultimately backfired.
"Domination and war bring only destruction."
Di Jiang shook his head, and his eyes gradually became firm and clear. No matter whether there was Hongjun's shadow behind that catastrophe or whether there was the calculation of other saints, the foundation of its destruction was the ancient world left by Pangu!
This is absolutely intolerable! "
He lowered his head and looked at the vast Pangu blood pool below.
According to the original trajectory, the Twelve Ancestral Witches used their own essence and blood to mix the energy of the blood pool to create countless people of the Witch Clan as the foundation for their struggle for hegemony.
But now, in this life, with my Emperor Jiang here, there is no need to use this method anymore.
Di Jiang soon made the decision that he would no longer use his own blood to create the witch clan on a large scale.
As for the six innate witches who are being conceived in the blood pool, they were naturally conceived by Pangu's blood pool and are the legal heirs. He will guide and train them.
But creating races on a large scale, getting involved in endless struggles for hegemony, and triggering catastrophes that would destroy the world, he would never take this path!
“Winning or losing this Lich War, I won’t be a part of it. "
A transcendent smile appeared at the corner of Di Jiang's mouth!
"How about winning? So what if you lose? Everything that was broken was my own stuff!
Hongjun wants to unite the Tao, and the Tao of Heaven wants to be perfected. Go and have fun on your own, don’t get involved with me, let alone destroy the foundation of the ancient world! "
Although he is a time traveler, he knows that in this ancient world, his identity as Pangu Zhengzong is his greatest reliance and foundation.
Maintaining the integrity and prosperity of the ancient world is, in a sense, maintaining the legitimacy and destiny of his own existence.
This is completely consistent with his blood instinct and self-interest.
"My path is to transcend, to protect, not to destroy. "
Di Jiang closed his eyes again, and the Tao Yun around him became more profound and mysterious, "Continuously improve his strength, until he reaches the level of Hunyuan Da Luo Jinxian, or even higher.
Only with enough power can you truly keep your word and protect Buzhou Mountain and the world created by Pangu in any storm. "
"As for those spiritual treasures and opportunities, they are just tools to protect the Tao.
The true Tao lies in oneself and the responsibility to this world. "
After figuring this out, Di Jiang felt that his Taoist heart was more transparent, and he and PanguThe blood fusion is also smoother.
He no longer dwells on the plot of his previous life, and is no longer eager to participate in prehistoric disputes.
What he has to do now is to stay in the safe zone of Buzhou Mountain, quietly accumulate strength, and wait for the opportunity.
When he has enough strength, he is naturally qualified to formulate rules and safeguard everything he wants to safeguard.
In Pangu Temple, the light of law once again enveloped Dijiang.
This time, he has a clearer goal and a firmer Taoist heart for the road ahead - to become stronger in order to protect.
Now that he had decided not to follow the old path of crazy troops and fighting for hegemony, Di Jiang set his sights on the six innate great witch blood fetuses in the Pangu blood pool.
These few people are the real essence of the future Wu Clan. They are the few of his own people in the prehistoric times, and they must be cultivated well.
